episode_title: Powerful storms hit the US, Supreme Court Rejects Missouri Maps, Mortgage Rates Rise
script_en: Powerful storms hit the US, Supreme Court Rejects Missouri Maps, Mortgage Rates Rise.
A weekend of wild weather as a couple of power storms are set to hit Hawaii and the Northeastern United States.
The Supreme Court rejects the new congressional maps in Missouri that favored republicans.
Mortgage rates and bond yields continue to rise, raising borrowing costs for both consumers and the government.
